text:
Anna Li: Quick check — planning to open the structured-output / fncall compat flag to a 5% prod canary tonight. Need ops + SDK + SRE sign-off. Goal is low-latency clients only, with rollback guardrails. Anyone object?
Jamal Singh: sounds fine. Do we have quota headroom on the dedicated pools for canary?
Claire Wu: ops: we have headroom but want an auto-rollback alert. Propose: rollback if error rate for fncall endpoints >0.5% over 5m. I can add an incident policy.
Marco Perez: Can we stage internal first? Suggest internal=100%, beta cohort=25%, prod_canary=5%. Safer to validate tooling outputs.
Sasha Ivanov: SDK note — compat flag toggles emitting "tools" vs raw string. Mobile needs a patch because it assumes old string shape. We'll gate mobile client builds behind the flag.
Priya Nair: SRE — please tag canary traffic with metric label `rollout=so_fncall_compat` so we can break down by audience. Also add a high-res trace rate for canary.
Ryan Gomez: config I propose for the flag rollout:```json
{"flag":"so_fncall_compat","audiences":[{"name":"internal","pct":100},{"name":"beta_users","pct":25},{"name":"prod_canary","pct":5}],"rollback":{"err_rate_pct":0.5,"window_mins":5},"metrics_label":"rollout=so_fncall_compat"}
```
Jamal Singh: will also add a quick smoke test in the model shim: if structured output schema missing required `name` field, return compat=false and log.
DeployBot: scheduled canary rollout job created — target start 2026-03-17T23:30:00Z, job id rb-2112349.
Claire Wu: :+1: adding the alert runbook and auto-rollback webhook. Will post the playbook link in a minute.
Sasha Ivanov: SDK release note: v1.2.4 will include the compat toggle and a soft-default of false. We'll cut canary SDK build tomorrow AM and coordinate with release engineering.
Anna Li: ok — plan: push flag config at 23:30 UTC, monitor 30m, then escalate. I'll create a short checklist and tag QA and mobile.
Priya Nair: SRE will watch latency and error rate dashboards; set a PagerDuty on call if rollback triggers.
Marco Perez: one ask — add a quick sampling of prompt+response hashes for canary only (PII-safe) so we can do quality diffs. Keep sample rate 0.1%.
Anna Li: noted, Marco. We'll keep sampling extremely small and scrubbed.
Jamal Singh: I'll be on call for the first 60 minutes. If anything funky, I'm ready to flip the flag or revert the shim.
Anna Li: thanks all. Proceeding with 5% prod canary per config above. I'll post ticket + checklist here when live. :eyes:
OpsBot: rollout job rb-2112349 queued. Notifications will be posted to #deployments when live.
Anna Li: closing for now — will update after first 10m monitoring window.
